name: TweakCC
headline: TweakCC - Customize Claude Code
short_description: Customize Claude Code's system prompts, create custom toolsets, add custom input pattern highlighters, custom themes/thinking verbs/spinner, input box style, user message display, sign-in ASCII art, fix bugs (frozen spinner), and add features (context limit customization). Supports both native (binary) and npm installs on all platforms.
author: Piebald-AI

sections.overview:
tweakcc is a customization tool for Claude Code that lets you modify system prompts, create custom toolsets, and personalize the UI with themes, input patterns, and visual elements. It supports both native binary and npm installations across Windows, macOS, and Linux. Users can fix bugs like frozen spinners, customize thinking verbs and spinner animations, style the input box, adjust user message display, and even modify sign-in ASCII art. The tool solves the problem of needing deeper control over Claude Code's behavior and appearance without forking the codebase. Developers who want Claude Code tailored to specific workflows benefit most from tweakcc's flexible customization options.
Customize system prompts to better align with your project's terminology and user experience.
Create and manage custom toolsets for specific tasks using the new /toolset command.
Highlight specific input patterns in the Claude Code input box for improved visibility and user feedback.
Develop unique themes that enhance the visual appeal of the Claude Code interface.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Piebald-AI/tweakcc`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
